export_modes.COMPACT: graph closure + recipes + manifests + results + explicit hash references to external pinned roots; not standalone
export_modes.PUBLICATION: selected claims/results plus exact evidence and computation closure, with scope statements and reproducibility instructions
export_modes.STANDALONE: transitive required root closure materialized into export; offline replay required

import: Verify archive, node identities, object hashes, schema versions, and edge referential integrity before merging. Never overwrite conflicting immutable node identity.
